shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: I currently have equal amounts of A, B, and C. Trading 1×A for 1×B would make my bundle less balanced (A:0, B:2, C:1), which reduces utility given my preference for variety.
Starting from an even bundle of 1A, 1B, 1C, trading 1B for 1A would make my inventory less balanced (2A, 0B, 1C). Since I value variety and currently value all goods equally, this lowers my utility.

Trading 1 B for 2 A changes my inventory from (1,1,1) to (3,0,1). Since all goods are valued equally and I prefer variety, this is less balanced, but receiving 2 units for 1 still increases my total holdings and is a favorable exchange based only on what I give and receive.
